changeSet.author: paypulse
changeSet.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS auth

changeSet.author: paypulse
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE auth.users ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, username VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE, password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE, roles VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPS', created_at TIMESTAMPTZ(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT (timezone('utc', now())) )

changeSet.author: paypulse
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE auth.refresh_tokens ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, token VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, fingerprint VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', family VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ(3) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT (timezone('utc', now())) )
CREATE INDEX idx_refresh_tokens_user ON auth.refresh_tokens (user_id, status)
CREATE INDEX idx_refresh_tokens_family ON auth.refresh_tokens (user_id, family)
